note: Organic Maps (app.organicmaps). The capture-90m fixture is pinned to a REAL en-GB capture (privacy-safe diagnostics export, 2026-07-29, Android 16): the title is the distance-to-turn '90 m' formatted with a non-breaking space (U+00A0, written \u00a0) exactly as the app sends it, and the text is the road. In the privacy-safe export the street was redacted, so a representative public street name stands in for it; the tested distance and the U+00A0 byte are the real ones. Organic Maps builds the identical navigation notification to its CoMaps fork (verified in OM NavigationService.java): the turn DIRECTION is only a graphical arrow icon, never text, so a card with no icon match expects UNKNOWN; the icon-* fixtures pin the drawable → maneuver map (iconDrawable, #74). Remaining fixtures are synthetic: units and a non-navigation notification that must not match.
